raw_segments.text: I write a few lines in haste to say that I am safe, and well advanced on my voyage.
This letter will reach England by a merchantman now on its homeward voyage from Archangel,
more fortunate than I, who may not see my native land perhaps for many years.
I am, however, in good spirits.
My men are bold and apparently firm of purpose, nor do the floating sheets of ice that continually
pass us, indicating the dangers of the region towards which we are advancing appear to dismay
We have already reached a very high latitude, but it is the height of summer, and although
